# Register a custom diagnostic

<small>Source: [`man/registerDiagnostic.Rd`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/man/registerDiagnostic.Rd) · Help: `?registerDiagnostic`</small>

Adds a function to the diagnostics registry so it can be called by `runHeteroTests`.

## Usage

```r
registerDiagnostic(name, fun)
```

## Arguments

`name`
:   Name of the diagnostic.

`fun`
:   Function taking `model` and `data` arguments.

## Value

Invisibly returns `NULL`.

## Details

A diagnostic registered this way is never cached by [`cachedTest`](cachedTest.md) or [`runHeteroTests`](runHeteroTests.md),
nor is a test of the package registered again under its name: whether it draws random numbers, or reads anything
besides the model and the data, cannot be known.

## See also

[`listDiagnostics`](listDiagnostics.md) for the names already registered.

## Examples

```r
custom <- function(model, data) list(statistic = 0)
registerDiagnostic("custom", custom)
```
